summary: Takeda Pharmaceutical filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 Annual Integrated Report for FY2025 (April 2025 – March 2026). The filing includes the President & CEO's message, financial results, and ESG commitments. It is a routine periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. The report is forward-looking but contains no deal terms, board recommendations, or transactional mechanics.
